notes.title: Patch 05/05/21
notes.notes:
-Main menu theme made significantly quieter
-Proc-spook indicators are quieter
-A short spook-blocker has been implemented to prevent spook spam
-An occasional glitch that causes the spook indicator to play over and over again has been fixed
-Game can now be paused by pressing escape

notes.title: Hotfix 3 : HUD fix
notes.notes: Very small update that fixes a HUD that carries over into the main menu upon exiting.

notes.title: Hotfix 2 : Red fade-in and camera shake fix
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue where the shampoo would fade to red, rather than black.
-Removed the very fast camera shake effect that would on rare occasions get stuck off center.

notes.title: Hotfix : Xray layer fix
notes.notes: Fixes an oversight where a certain spook was not X-rayed and thus not visible to the player.
